Not two monsters of this land are quite alike.

Archetypes: every monster has a nature - aggressive, a mage, a supporter that heals its kin, a coward that runs - and fights with real skills of that nature.

Hidden strengths: monsters may be born with passive skills, such as resistances or masteries. A monster with many of them glows with an aura. They are tougher, but give more experience and better loot.

Rage: a monster that is stunned or held too many times may fly into a [RAGE]. It grows larger, hits harder and faster, and shrugs off most debuffs for a while. Don't rely on the same stun forever.
